jobs.occupation: Sr KAM Off Trade - Non food company
jobs.description:
The company is a leading international FMCG player in the non-food sector, offering a diverse portfolio of trusted consumer products across categories such as personal care, household, and lifestyle essentials. Known for its strong brands, innovation-driven mindset, and commitment to sustainability, it combines global scale with local market expertise. The organization places a strong emphasis on quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement, making it a dynamic and forward-thinking environment within the fast-moving consumer goods industry.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior KAM, you will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of key retail accounts, developing tailored commercial strategies to drive distribution, visibility, and long-term profitable growth. You will act as the primary point of contact for your customers, ensuring strong partnerships and flawless execution in the market.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage and develop strategic relationships with key off-trade customers in the non-food channel.
• Negotiate annual agreements, pricing, and promotional plans to deliver sustainable growth.
• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned with customer and company objectives.
• Drive distribution, shelf presence, and visibility of product ranges across retail partners.
• Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer performance to identify opportunities.
• Collaborate closely with marketing, supply chain, and category teams to ensure execution excellence.
• Deliver against sales, profitability, and market share targets.
• Provide regular performance analysis and strategic recommendations to senior management.

• Proven experience in Key Account Management within FMCG, preferably in non-food or general merchandise.
• Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation skills.
• Ability to build long-term, trust-based relationships with retail partners.
• Analytical mindset with strong understanding of sales data and category performance.
• Entrepreneurial, proactive, and results-oriented approach.
• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Vehicle Technician Wanted – Automotive Maintenance Specialist Rumst
jobs.description:
As a vehicle technician, you are responsible for the maintenance and repair of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles of all makes. You will work in a spacious, modern body shop known for its craftsmanship and customer focus. The workshop specializes in both conventional and electric/hybrid vehicles, so you'll work with the latest automotive technologies.

On a typical day, you’ll independently carry out both minor and major maintenance services. You diagnose technical issues using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and perform mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs. Quality is key, and you ensure every vehicle leaves the workshop in top condition.

Are you a precise, self-reliant technician with a passion for cars? Apply now and become part of a dedicated team. Together, you’ll ensure satisfied customers and vehicles in perfect working order.

• Diploma in automotive technology at secondary education level or equivalent through experience

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a car technician

• Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and systems

• Able to work independently and accurately

• Proficient in English, both spoken and written

• Holder of a valid category B driver’s license

• Passion for vehicles and new technologies

Main Responsibilities

The Technical Sales Manager contributes annually to the development of a strategic sales plan, in consultation with management (including objectives, KPIs, segmentation, and action points). In addition, weekly consultations and monthly reporting will be required.

Building and expanding a proactive and sustainable network of customers, prospects, partners (suppliers, machine builders, ...)

In most projects, the Technical Sales Manager will act as coordinator between customers, engineering offices, partners, suppliers, and the Revimaxx team.

You continuously monitor the market and trends and also share these internally. You pay attention to developments in technologies, relationships between customers/partners, subcontracting, opportunities, ...

You are open to and contribute to active marketing support, social media communication, participation in trade fairs, training sessions, ...

In this role, a combination of technical/mechanical expertise and a sense for economic reality is necessary. This may have been built through experience, interest, education... or perhaps through a combination of these.

• Industrial Engineer, Civil Engineer, or equivalent through experience
• Initial technical sales and/or consultancy experience (with technical expertise) and demonstrable results are a must, with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
• You have a strong affinity with the machine construction sector and are passionate about the mechanical possibilities of small and large machines/systems.
• Your commercial experience motivates you to independently evaluate opportunities and pursue them.
• You are conceptually strong and enjoy thinking together with the customer in a co-creative way to arrive at the best solution for their challenge.
• You are analytical and skilled with numbers in order to quickly determine margins and feasibility of projects. You have a sense for the economic reality of each project.
• You possess strong communication skills and communicate effectively with customers, partners, and the Revimaxx team. (knowledge of perfect English, and willingness to learn Dutch quickly)

• You are results-oriented, loyal, flexible, and demonstrate strong perseverance.

Our client in the Ghent region is an international company with a production site where highly regulated processes are carried out. The environment is modern, structured and safety‑focused. You will join a team where quality, collaboration and precision are key.

Your new role
As a Lab Technician, you will perform quality control on advanced therapies in a GMP environment. You will take samples, carry out analyses (including flow cytometry and glucose testing), and monitor the cleanroom environment (ISO 5). You will work closely with Quality and Operations, manage test results in LIMS, and contribute to optimizing processes and documentation.

What do we expect from you?

• Bachelor's degree in lab technology, biotechnology or equivalent
• Knowledge of GMP and quality standards (FDA/EU)
• Experience with aseptic techniques or cleanrooms is a plus
• Strong communication skills in Dutch and technical English
• Accurate, well-organized and a true team player

Ghent Region | Leadership experience | GMP & cleanroom | Shift system | 1110509

About the organization
Our client is an international manufacturing company active in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector. From their site in Flanders, they produce innovative therapies that improve patients' lives worldwide. The organization is known for its high-tech environment, strong growth, and a culture where collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement are key.

Your new role
As a Production Supervisor, you are the heartbeat of a GMP manufacturing environment. You lead operational teams and ensure that all processes meet the highest standards of quality and safety.

Your responsibilities include:

• Leadership and coaching: Motivate and guide production teams in a cleanroom environment.
• Compliance and audits: Ensure adherence to cGMP standards and act as a key contact during inspections.
• Documentation management: Oversee procedures, batch records, and ensure timely release.
• Process improvement: Initiate projects to enhance efficiency, quality, and safety.
• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with QA, QC, Engineering, and Supply Chain.
• Training: Ensure your team is well-trained and foster a culture of ownership and learning.
You will report directly to the Operations Manager.

 

What we expect from you

• Bachelor or Master degree in science, bioengineering, pharmacy, or equivalent through experience
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or pharma
• Knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations
• Strong communication and organizational skills
• Proficiency in MS Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus
• Fluent in English (Dutch is an asset)

Develop and optimize yeast protein applications across various food systems, including sports nutrition, dairy alternatives, and bakery products.
Lead formulation design and iterative prototyping for functionality performance, including texture optimization, emulsification, gelation, etc.
Evaluate and interpret sensory data to guide formulation decisions and product optimization strategies.
Conduct competitor benchmarking and market trend analysis in protein and functional ingredient applications.
Translate customer briefs and market requirements into robust technical solutions and scalable product formulations.
Support customer-facing technical projects, including sample development, technical troubleshooting, and presentations.
Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and regional/global R&D teams to support business-driven product development and innovation.
Ensure compliance with regulatory, quality, and internal R&D standards.

Master's degree in Food Science, Food Engineering, or a related discipline.

experience are also encouraged to apply.
Strong sensory evaluation capability with structured sensory thinking and product profiling experience.
Solid understanding of ingredient functionality, protein behavior, and food matrix interactions.
Ability to independently design experiments and interpret technical data.
Strong problem-solving skills in formulation troubleshooting and product optimization.
Good communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional and customerfacing environments.
